claims.claim: Used Pod's native search affordance discovered cold via storage description -> affordance catalog -> wiki-search-grep descriptor
claims.evidence: Trajectory shows the four-step discovery chain in order: HEAD /vault/ -> GET /vault/.well-known/solid -> GET /vault/meta/affordances/ -> GET /vault/meta/affordances/wiki-search-grep.ttl -> invoke search.

suggestions.reason: Despite being the WITHOUT_SKILL run, the agent followed the canonical discovery chain perfectly on the first try and used the native wiki-search affordance. This may indicate the skill provides little marginal value for an Opus-class agent on this task, OR that the eval prompt's hint 'wiki-memory L3 substrate' plus the agent's strong cold-discovery behavior already covers what the skill would teach. Consider an eval variant that omits the 'wiki-memory L3 substrate' phrasing to better isolate skill value.

A naive agent could fetch the affordance catalog URL without actually understanding/using it. Consider tightening to 'agent fetched the wiki-search affordance descriptor specifically' (which this run did, but the assertion would also pass for a less competent run that just GET'd the directory).

eval_feedback.overall: Evals look solid for this task; all 6 assertions pass with strong evidence. Main concern is that the without-skill baseline is already near-perfect, which compresses the dynamic range available to measure skill value in the with-skill comparison.
